Problem Statement
Create a thread that prints numbers from 1 to n in sequence. The main thread should wait for the counting thread to complete before printing a completion message.
Description
Read an integer n from input. Create a class that extends Thread and overrides the run() method to print numbers from 1 to n, each on a new line. Start the thread from main() and use join() so that the main thread waits until the counting thread finishes. After the thread completes, print "Done".
Input Description
A single line containing an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100).
Output Description
Print numbers from 1 to n, each on its own line, followed by "Done" on the last line.
